name: sBOLD by K3 Capital
oneLiner: sBOLD is K3 Capital's ERC-4626 wrapper of BOLD; deposits route to Liquity V2 Stability Pools to earn interest and liquidation gains, with BOLD-tier CDP risk.
collateral: BOLD deposited into K3's ERC-4626 sBOLD vault and allocated across Liquity V2 Stability Pools to earn interest and liquidation gains
pegMechanism: Vault shares appreciate against BOLD as Stability Pool interest and liquidation gains are compounded; liquidation collateral is converted back to BOLD by mutable solver/swap infrastructure, so final value inherits BOLD peg and K3 execution risk

deployedExposure.basis: sBOLD deploys BOLD into Liquity V2 Stability Pools; totalAssets() includes compounded and pending pool BOLD, any internal BOLD balance, and liquidation collateral valued in BOLD net of swap slippage and fees

slice.name: BOLD deployed into Liquity V2 Stability Pools

notices.title: Exploited: vault paused, do not deposit
notices.message: K3 Capital's sBOLD vault stays paused, holding 4.58 BOLD against 43.72M shares after attackers drained about 3.43M BOLD on November 18, 2026 via an unused 1inch router approval. Liquity V2, BOLD, and 1inch were unaffected. Counterparties returned 190.66 ETH and 131,316 BOLD by November 23 under K3's bounty, with no depositor payout schedule announced; Pharos withholds supply and market cap.
